verses.text: Ha ix Sara 127 ab'il sk'inal ix,
ayik ix cham ix t'a chonhab' Quiriat-arba, haton Hebrón t'a yol yik Canaán. Ix te ok' winhaj Abraham yuj schamel ix Sara chi', ix ochkan winh t'a kusk'olal yuj ix.
Ix kan sniwanil ix yetb'eyum winh chi', ix b'at winh t'a heb' hitita kajan t'a jun lugar chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik:
--Wach'chom ch'ok chonhab'il wajek' t'a he kal, palta elokab' t'a he k'ol tze chonh jab'ok in lu'um b'aj tzin muk sniwanil ix wetb'eyum chi', xchi winh t'a heb'.
Ix tak'wi heb' t'a winh:

--Mamin, ab' tas ol kal t'ayach, a ach tik te niwan elk'och t'a ko kal tik, yuj chi' syal a mukan a chamnak chi' b'aj te wach' t'a ko kampusante. Malaj junok onh max ko cha a muk sniwanil ix etb'eyum chi' t'a k'e'en k'e'en joyb'ilel yo'ol, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Haxo winhaj Abraham chi', ix k'e linhan winh, ix em nhojnaj winh yik sch'oxan winh to ay yelk'och heb' winh t'a sat winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Tato yel tz'el t'a he k'ol tzin muk sniwanil ix wetb'eyum chi' t'a tik, alek t'a winhaj Efrón, yuninal winhaj Zohar
to schonh k'e'en nhak'e'en winh t'ayin t'a Macpela t'a stitak slu'um winh. Ol in tup t'a winh icha stojol yik swikejkan jun lugar chi' b'aj tzin muk in chamnak t'a he kal, xchi winhaj Abraham chi'.
Ayek' winhaj Efrón hitita chi' t'a skal heb'. Ix tak'wi winh. Te cha'anh ix yal winh yik wach' syab' masanil heb' yetchonhab' molanek' chi' yet' heb' tz'och t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Ix yalan winh:

--Ma'ay mamin, swal t'ayach to a jun nhak'e'en yet' lum lum chi' tonhej tzin si'ej t'ayach. Testigo tz'ajkan heb' wetchonhab' tik to tonhej tzin si'ej jun lum chi' t'ayach. Muk ix etb'eyum chi' ta', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix emxi nhojnaj winhaj Abraham chi' t'a yichanh heb' ayek' chi',
ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Efrón t'a yichanh heb' smasanil: --Ab' wal tas swal t'ayach to tza cha stojol lu'um, ichato chi' ol in mukan ix wetb'eyum chi' ta', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Efrón chi':
--Ab' jun mamin, 400 siclo k'e'en plata stojol lu'um. Yujto a ach, swak' lum t'ayach icha jun stojol chi', toxonhej b'at a muk ix, xchi winh.
Ix scha sk'ol stojol lum chi' winhaj Abraham icha ix yal winh t'a yichanh masanil heb' winh hitita chi'. Ix stupan lum winh icha ix aj strato heb' chi'.

Icha chi' ix aj yochkan lum slu'um winhaj Efrón chi' yikok winhaj Abraham chi', lum Macpela t'a slak'anil lum yik winhaj Mamre, b'aj ay k'e'en nhak'e'en yet' te te'. Ix yikejkan masanil juntzanh chi' winh.
Ix yikejkan lum winhaj Abraham chi' t'a yichanh masanil heb' winh hitita molanek' ta'. Masanil heb' tz'och t'a spuerta'il chonhab' chi', testigo pax ix ajkan heb' t'a jun trato chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix smukankan ix yetb'eyum winh chi' t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a lum Macpela chi', t'a slak'anil slum winhaj Mamre t'a Hebrón t'a yol yik Canaán.
Icha chi' ix aj schonhankanel slum heb' winh hitita yet' k'e'en olan k'e'en t'a winhaj Abraham b'aj smuk schamnak.
